bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement and no generate gate. Auxiliary requant is a CPU LS refit of scale/zero (or a real u8 encode of the incumbent f16 aux) on sealed-3.14 HGRAVF01 tensors. Weight-space is reconstructed-W rel-fro vs the incumbent affine. Organ-space is held-out SwiGLU error on the real teacher corpus, split by prompt_id. Logit-space is KL and top-k agreement of the real LM head applied to last-layer organ outputs on held-out prompts; it is not a full-stack generate identity. Argmax agreement is recorded and is not parity. Byte figures come from tools/future/executable_economics.py. evidence_class is STATIC_ONLY. gpu_authority is false.

assumptions.bandwidth_note: production-shaped affine-Q2. The size curve saturates at 376.7 GB/s and does not rise toward 497.4. A 5 MB launch is 223.4 GB/s; that is a different regime (affine_q2_unamortized).
assumptions.dispatch_note: measured class mlp_gqa_norm_fusion at 6.25 us; class-dependent, not a single marginal

logit_space.note: LM head is the sealed HQ30UQ4 table. Inputs are last-layer organ outputs on prompt-split hold rows, not the residual stream. Full-stack generate identity is UNMEASURED (no GPU lease). Argmax is not parity.

organ_space.note: Held-out by prompt_id on the real teacher corpus. Y is incumbent F(X)=down(silu(gate(X))*up(X)); Y_hat is the same organ after the auxiliary requant.

sensitivity_concentration.why: must-keep mean rel-fro 0.270622 vs could-take 0.269676; injury is not concentrated on the high-sensitivity slices

weight_space.note: Rel-fro of reconstructed W vs incumbent affine-Q2 G=64. Group-size levers are a real LS refit at the new G, not an analytic bound. u8 keeps the 2-bit codes and requants aux.

mlp_byte_census_where.note: The 1.07 GB is the sum of 192 HGRAVF01 scale+bias+header parts on mlp.gate/up/down, reconciled by mlp_auxiliary_information.accounting.

overlap_relations.why: Two points on the same aux(G)=4*n_params/G+58176 curve. A tensor has one group size; the saves are not additive.
Both attack the same 1.07 GB of f16 scale/bias. PATH_TO_71 already records they must not be summed.
u8-at-G=1024 is a different packing, not the sum of the two byte claims. Composing them without a new fit is forbidden.
Heterogeneous G=1024 is a restricted allocation of the same lever: coarse G only on map-supported slices. Its bytes are a subset of uniform G=1024.
Heterogeneous G still rewrites the same scale/bias arrays u8 would quantize.

purpose: Capability screen for the three OPEN auxiliary byte levers on the 1.07 GB of MLP scale/bias/header, plus a heterogeneous allocator that is the first use of the sensitivity map as a byte-placement rule rather than a byte claim.
what_this_does_not_prove: generate identity (no GPU lease, no resident generate gate)
full-stack logits under a perturbation of every layer at once
that a FITTED_HELDOUT lever is QUALIFIED on the resident
physical EBPW of a different packing
